purpose: development-only comparison of fixed pretrained decision models

laya_typed.api: fixed local laya.load(checkpoint, device=cpu, backend=eager, compile=false).predict(state, unchanged dev-v3 questions)
laya_typed.question_data: Original dev-v3 instructions, candidate ids, criteria and order
laya_typed.output_handling: Preserve official answers and probabilities; do not re-round or recalibrate outside the checkpoint API.

gliner25_multi_decide.tokenization: Official checkpoint default processor and word splitter; no character-splitting variant. The official processor punctuation normalization is recorded.
gliner25_multi_decide.input: Pass the unchanged state as text and the unchanged dev-v3 instructions as the task prompt. Preserve exact question, ordered labels, and processor-generated input id hash in each record.
gliner25_multi_decide.classification: One classify_text single-label task per dev-v3 case. Choice uses contract candidate ids and criteria descriptions in source order; Score uses ordered ids 0/1/2 and criteria descriptions; Noul uses fixed ids true/false with descriptions for the deadline-notification-candidate meaning.
gliner25_multi_decide.confidence: Record only the selected-label confidence returned by include_confidence=true. It is not a calibrated probability, a full class vector, or P(true).
gliner25_multi_decide.score: Record the selected integer stage. Do not derive a continuous Score or expected value unless the official API returns all class probabilities; this checkpoint's public formatter returns only selected-label confidence.
gliner25_multi_decide.abstention: No result-tuned confidence threshold. Contract errors, length excess and execution failures remain distinct; an ordinary selected label is not described as certainty.

gliner_noul_labels.false: 期限通知の候補に該当しない
gliner_noul_labels.true: 期限通知の候補に該当する

performance.single_judgment_inputs: First fixed dev-v3 input for each type; repeated unchanged
performance.bundle_input: First fixed dev-v3 choice input; three type questions evaluated in one official API call
performance.idle_cpu_measurement: process CPU-time delta during the 60-second no-input wait

comparisons.reuse_policy: Read only when dataset, input, scoring-contract and result fingerprints match dev-v3; do not rerun or rewrite old Runs.
comparisons.quality_status: UNDETERMINED until all labels receive human confirmation
comparisons.control_labels: AI-authored technical controls; report separately from dev-v3 and do not call human-verified
